The '''Minev-Ra Caves''' was a series of [[Cave/Legends|caves]] located in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and criminals, and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scratch (individual)|Scratch]] operated a trading post out of the caves.
